items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: Connie Francis was in that movie. I mean that was a movie. I mean they made a movie. I wasn’t — it was before I was with the band.

ctx.x: No, but I know the band you’re talking about. This was a very hyped up shuffle —
Yeah there was a lot of different people — Connie Francis was in that movie. I mean that was a movie. I mean they made a movie. I wasn’t — it was before I was with the band.
What did being “on the road” constitute? Like one nighters in dance clubs?
